method.method_draft: Read the diagram first: quadrilateral X-Y-Z-W is drawn as a trapezoid with bottom base XY labeled 20, top base WZ labeled 8, and the interior angle at Y marked 70°. The question text states that XYZW is an isosceles trapezoid and asks for m∠Z. Use the trapezoid property that the two bases are parallel, so XY ∥ WZ. Along the right leg YZ, angles ∠Y and ∠Z are same-side interior angles formed by a transversal crossing parallel lines, so they are supplementary. Therefore m∠Z = 180° - 70° = 110°.
method.CoT_raw:

推理：梯形的两底平行，所以 XY ∥ WZ。右侧边 YZ 是一条截线，穿过这两条平行线，因此同旁内角 ∠Y 和 ∠Z 互补。已知 ∠Y = 70°，所以 m∠Z = 180° - 70° = 110°。
